messages:
Maya (PM Partnerships): Quick sync: ShadowRun joint perf run this Wed 09:00 PT. Primary objectives: perf-per-watt (joules/token), sustained throughput at 99th pct latency SLAs, and two kernel-flag variants. Need NDA sign, creds, and a minimal smoke checklist by EOD. Who owns the runbook?
Tom (ShadowRun HW): I can own on ShadowRun side. We can provide a single NIMBLE32 node and raw power telemetry. NDA out to your legal now. We prefer sftp drop, but can do presigned S3.
Asha (Eng-Perf): We'll run our bench image: ghcr.io/redwood/bench:2026-dayzero. Please ensure kernel debug is enabled so we can grab kallsyms and dmesg. Kernel toggles: improved_kv_cache=on/off and l2_prefetch=on/off. We'll automate reboots.
Luis (Partner Eng): Metric schema for downstream ingest: tokens_per_sec, p50_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, avg_power_w, joules_per_token, kv_cache_hit_ratio, gpu_util_pct. Put run metadata in run_meta.json at s3://redwood-shadowrun/bench/<ts>/<run_id>/run_meta.json
Kevin (Eng-SRE): Networking: allowlist ShadowRun egress 52.12.34.56 -> bench infra 10.0.12.0/22 on 22,443,9000. I'll create temp IAM role and bucket lifecycle. Send SSH pubkey fingerprint to pin.
Tom (ShadowRun HW): SSH fingerprint: SHA256:AbC123xYz987+EXAMPLE. We'll deposit creds into partner-vault when NDA clears. We can stream /sys/class/thermal and IPMI logs over sftp.
Asha (Eng-Perf): Sample run commands and sampling hooks:
```
# start nvml power sampling
nohup nvidia-smi --query-gpu=power.draw,utilization.gpu --format=csv -l 1 > power.csv &
# perf counters
perf stat -e cycles,instructions -o perf.txt -- bench run --image ghcr.io/redwood/bench:2026-dayzero --workload=redwood-llama7b --concurrency=8 --seq-len=2048 --seed=42 --out s3://redwood-shadowrun/bench/$TS/$RUN_ID/
```
Also capture dmesg, kernel-config (zcat /proc/config.gz), and nv-hostengine logs.
Luis (Partner Eng): We'll run baseline (stock kernel) then variant A (improved_kv_cache=1) then variant B (improved_kv_cache=1 + l2_prefetch=1). Please include a warmup phase 5min each and 3 steady-state samples per variant.
Maya (PM Partnerships): Success criteria for go/no-go: p50 within 10% of baseline and joules_per_token reduced by at least 8% OR tokens_per_sec increased by >=5% at comparable power. We'll also include a customer-facing note template in case we publish joint findings.
bench-bot: Auto: scheduled smoke run Wed 2026-03-25T16:00:00Z (09:00 PT). Run tag: shadowrun-kernel-smoke. Command queued.
Kevin (Eng-SRE): Reminder: do not use any customer PII. Use synthetic prompt set seeded by bench image. Bucket policy will expire in 72h.
Maya (PM Partnerships): Next actions: 1) Tom: confirm NDA + creds; 2) Asha: push toggle script and bench config to gh repo; 3) Kevin: create bucket + allowlist; 4) Luis: finalize metric JSON. I'll post the one-page runbook here when ready. Any blockers?
Tom (ShadowRun HW): NDA in flight. We also have a thermal cam feed; can enable read-only stream for debugging if helpful.
Asha (Eng-Perf): Thermal cam optional but useful for thermal throttling correlation. I'll add a short telemetry map to the runbook. See you Wed. :rocket:
